newsitem.title: JORDAN: PLO's Arafat ends talks with Jordan's King Hussein.
newsitem.headline: PLO's Arafat ends talks with Jordan's King Hussein.

text.p: Palestinian President Yasser Arafat and Jordan's King Hussein agreed in talks on Wednesday in the Red Sea port of Aqaba on the need to push ahead the stalled Middle East peace process, the state news agency reported.
Both stressed the need to "work with parties outside the region to push forward the peace process and getting it back on its natural course and removing obstacles in its way," Petra news agency said.
Arafat went to the king's seaside palace, where the monarch is recuperating after recent prostate surgery, to brief him on the stalled Israeli-Palestinian peace process, officials said.

They said Arafat sought the king's support to put pressure on Israel to implement peace accords and relaunch the process, which plunged into crisis after Israel's decision to build a Jewish settlement in Arab East Jerusalem.

They said Arafat briefed the king on the latest talks held by Palestinian negotiators with U.S. officials in Washington and his meeting with Israeli Foreign Minister David Levy on the sidelines of last week's European-Mediterranean conference in Malta.

The king's intervention helped early in the year to seal a long-delayed accord on Israeli troop withdrawal from 80 percent of the West Bank town of Hebron and a timetable for further redeployment from the West Bank.
